concepts.title: Percent as a rate per hundred
At least as an inclusive minimum
No more than as an inclusive maximum

misconceptions.combine_instead_of_compare: Learner adds both groups when the task asks for a gap.
misconceptions.reversed_subtraction: Learner subtracts in the wrong order.
misconceptions.object_instead_of_relationship: Learner chooses a group instead of the relationship.
misconceptions.gap_as_unknown: Learner reports the known difference instead of finding the missing compared amount.
misconceptions.division_multiply_groups: Learner multiplies because groups are mentioned even though a fixed total is being shared.
misconceptions.division_group_count: Learner confuses the known number of groups with the unknown size of one group.
misconceptions.division_unequal_groups: Learner assumes equal shares must be whole numbers or permits unequal group sizes.
misconceptions.fraction_counts_only: Learner treats numerator and denominator as unrelated counts or compares digits instead of fraction magnitude.
misconceptions.fraction_unequal_parts: Learner counts pieces without preserving one named whole and equal part sizes.
misconceptions.fraction_less_than_one: Learner assumes every fraction must be less than one.
misconceptions.percent_whole_number: Learner treats a percent as a detached whole number instead of a rate per hundred.
misconceptions.percent_wrong_whole: Learner does not identify the base whole represented by 100 percent.
misconceptions.percent_conversion_only: Learner applies a conversion procedure without preserving the part-to-whole relationship.
misconceptions.area_boundary_confusion: Learner measures or counts the outside boundary when the question asks for interior coverage.
misconceptions.area_corner_count: Learner treats corner count as a measure of the region's coverage.
misconceptions.area_fixed_answer: Learner generalizes one rectangular model's area to every rectangle.
misconceptions.area_add_sides: Learner adds dimensions instead of counting the rectangular array of square units.
misconceptions.area_perimeter_confusion: Learner uses a perimeter calculation or boundary claim to answer an area question.
misconceptions.area_dimension_match: Learner assumes equal area requires identical side lengths.
misconceptions.perimeter_area_confusion: Learner uses interior coverage or an area calculation to answer a boundary-distance question.
misconceptions.perimeter_partial_boundary: Learner totals only part of the outside path and omits one or more sides.
misconceptions.perimeter_unit_rule: Learner treats linear-unit labeling as a shape-specific rule rather than a consequence of measuring distance.
misconceptions.perimeter_single_dimension: Learner compares one side length instead of totaling each complete boundary.
misconceptions.at_least_reversed_direction: Learner reads least as a cue for smaller values instead of reasoning from a minimum.
misconceptions.at_least_excludes_boundary: Learner excludes the stated minimum even though at least includes equality.
misconceptions.at_least_boundary_only: Learner includes the minimum but omits greater allowed values.
misconceptions.at_least_keyword_only: Learner selects a symbol from one word without testing the boundary and direction.
misconceptions.no_more_than_reversed_direction: Learner reads more as a cue for greater values instead of reasoning from a maximum.
misconceptions.no_more_than_excludes_boundary: Learner excludes the stated maximum even though no more than includes equality.
misconceptions.no_more_than_boundary_only: Learner includes the maximum but omits smaller allowed values.
misconceptions.no_more_than_keyword_only: Learner selects a symbol from one word without testing the boundary and direction.
